judgment: It is good to ford the great river.
Three days before the first day,
three days after the first day.
image: So the noble one stirs the people up
lines: He sorts out his father's spoiling.
There is danger, but in the end: good.
He sorts out his mother's spoiling:
He sorts out his father's spoiling:
He lets his father's spoiling be.
If he goes on, he will meet shame.
He sorts out his father's spoiling,
He does not serve kings and lords,
but holds his own work high.

notes.name_en: 蠱 is rot bred in a vessel — work inherited spoiled; 'Spoiling'.
notes.judgment: 甲 is the first of the ten stem-days; rendered 'the first day'.
notes.L1: 幹 is managing/sorting out (the trunk-work); 考 the (late) father.
